DRPLAY chunk: played one random 4x4 game against the oracle and compared the played result with the table's stored value for the start position. VERDICT: AGREE - played result equals the table's predicted value exactly on a chainable (L==H) node. No disagreement, no crisis finding.

Start position (set up from empty by play B D4, play W D3, play B A3, play W D2, play B D1, play W A1 - no captures during setup, every stone has >=1 liberty): Black {D4,A3,D1}, White {D3,D2,A1}, 6 stones, Black to move. Board (top = row 4): ". . . X / X . . O / . . . O / O . . X". Area score of the position = 0 (3 Black stones, 3 White stones). colex index 568868 (independent colex-keyed artifact2.lookup read, the same bounds2 path the engine uses).

How the position was chosen: a deterministic random search over legal positions (every group with >=1 liberty) of 4-8 stones; the search queried the artifact's stored L/H for the side-to-move and selected a chainable (L==H) node with an intermediate value (|v| not in {0,16}). This is seed 49 in that search. The intermediate value is the point: a +/-16 result ("one side takes the whole goban") is degenerate, while a +3 prediction is a non-trivial exact claim that play can genuinely falsify.

Table row at the start (Black to move, ko=none, passes=0): L=3 H=3 (chainable, ko_sensitive=no), pinned value v0 = +3. Confirmed by three independent reads, all agreeing: (1) the engine's weizigo_chaincheck b -> "a1=1 a2=1 move=C2 v0=3"; (2) the engine's first genmove diagnostic -> stored-v0=3 [L=3,H=3]; (3) an independent artifact2.lookup keyed by colex -> side=B L=3 H=3 pinned=3. (Aside, not a contradiction: the same position with White to move reads L=H=-16 - the fresh-start value is side-to-move dependent; the game is Black to move.)

Played it out with bin/weizigo-gtp (e890b5a-dirty built 2026-08-22T18:36:30Z, zig 0.16.0) on data/oracle-4x4-v2.wzo2 (sha256 0c3366f07fb33c6f2838ead48ad3080b64dbe55935b87af4f140d81a29e4e15a, 4x4 WZO2, rules_id 3 Chinese area, komi 0, basic ko, L/H bracket). The engine alternated both colours (Black first). Full line: B C2, W C3, B B3, W C4, B B2, W C1, B B1, W B4, B D1, W pass, B C1, W pass, B A2, W pass, B pass. Game ended on two consecutive passes (15 genmoves, no resignations). final_score = B+3 = +3 Black-positive.

Every genmove diagnostic along the line reported stored-v0=3 [L=3,H=3] with dtt stepping 12->0; no KO_SENSITIVE, no HISTORY-DIVERGED, no UNCHAINABLE refusal. Session stats: lookups=368 misses=0 fallbacks=0 genmoves=15 (zero lookup misses - every state reached was in the artifact).

VERDICT: AGREE - played result +3 equals the table's stored value +3 exactly on a chainable L==H node. This is a fresh-start (C1) consistency check on the chainable region, NOT a real-game claim: C2 (single-score history-independence) stays falsified at 3x2 (T13) and C3 (bracket bounds real-game score) stays falsified at 3x3 (E2). Play cannot prove the table; it can only falsify it. This chunk found no disagreement, so no crisis finding.
